_about: Word start/end per beat, seconds from the start of each beat file in audio/ (start_in_beat) and from the start of animatic v4 (animatic). Measured 2026-10-23: ElevenLabs Scribe transcript of a reference take, carried onto our file by MFCC + DTW alignment (build/word_timings/align_words.py). Validated: 99% of word starts within 1 frame (33 ms) on stretched test recordings; every measured pause in our files falls on a word boundary. Word ends before punctuation are cut at the start of the following silence.
